questions.question:
A: What will we do in Alishan?
B: We will go ______. The mountains are beautiful.
questions.commonMisconception: 不具備地點與活動的邏輯連結。
questions.explanation: 在山區 (mountains) 常見的活動是健行 (hiking)。

questions.question: I ______ visit my grandparents next summer vacation.
questions.commonMisconception: 混淆 will 與 be going to 結構（此題後方無 going to，故優先選 will）。
questions.explanation: 未來簡單式動詞原形前加助動詞 will 表示預計執行動作。

questions.question: Don't forget to take a ______! This place is great.
questions.commonMisconception: 不認識固定搭配詞。
questions.explanation: take a picture 為固定用法，「拍照」之意。

questions.question:
A: ______ Lily go to the concert with us tomorrow?
B: Yes, she will.
questions.commonMisconception: 慣性選 Does 或 Is，未注意時態對應。
questions.explanation: 未來簡單式的疑問句，使用助動詞 Will 開頭，且回答也是用 will。

questions.question: It ______ rain tomorrow. You should bring an umbrella.
questions.commonMisconception: 受 tomorrow 影響誤選 is (應為 is going to 才對)。
questions.explanation: 描述明天的天氣預測，使用 will rain。

questions.question:
A: Will you play basketball after school?
B: No, I ______. I have to study.
questions.commonMisconception: 習慣性選 don't，忽略助動詞的一致性。
questions.explanation: 對 Will 開頭疑問句的否定簡答為 No, I won't (will not)。

questions.question: Sam and Leo ______ go swimming if the weather is hot.
questions.commonMisconception: 受主詞複數影響誤選 are。
questions.explanation: 表示未來的可能計畫，選用 will。

questions.question: She will ______ us a story tonight.
questions.commonMisconception: 受單三影響加 s，或受已發生的事影響加 ed。
questions.explanation: 助動詞 will 之後應接「原形動詞」。

questions.question: Amy ______ see a movie with her mom next Sunday.
questions.commonMisconception: 對 be going to 的殘缺形式辨識力不足。
questions.explanation: 未來式最標準助動詞為 will。選項 B 缺少 to，D 項目缺少 B 動詞。

questions.question:
We will take the forest train in Alishan. We will see the beautiful sunrise (日出). 
Question: What time will they most likely wake up?
questions.commonMisconception: 對自然現象與生活作息的邏輯連結不夠敏銳。
questions.explanation: 要看日出 (sunrise)，通常需要「清晨非常早」起床。

questions.question:
Friday: Rain. Saturday: Sunny. Sunday: Cloudy.
Question: Which day will be the best for hiking?
questions.commonMisconception: 資訊比對錯誤，或不認識天氣單字。
questions.explanation: 晴天 (Sunny) 最適合戶外健行。

questions.question:
We are going camping. I will bring my tent. Amy will bring the food. Ken stays home.
Question: Does Ken go camping with them?
questions.commonMisconception: 沒看清楚問句時態或簡答格式要求。
questions.explanation: 文中說 Ken stays home，故他不去露營。針對未來問句，回答用 won't。D 雖然語意對，但簡答格式未對應問句。

questions.question:
Next year, Leo will learn how to play the guitar. He wants to form a band.
Question: What is Leo's future plan?
questions.commonMisconception: 不懂 form a band 的含義。
questions.explanation: 他要學吉他並「組樂團」(form a band)，故未來計畫是在樂團演奏。

questions.question:
If you visit the zoo, you will see elephants. If you visit the mountains, you will see birds. 
Question: What will you see if you go hiking?
questions.commonMisconception: 無法進行活動與地點的同義/類義轉換。
questions.explanation: 去爬山 (mountains) 對應去健行 (hiking)，會看到的是鳥類。

questions.question: My father ______ go to Taipei and visit his friend tomorrow.
questions.commonMisconception: 誤以為只能擇一使用，或是對 A and B 的選項模式不熟悉。
questions.explanation: 未來式可以使用 will 也可以使用 be going to。此題檢驗學生對未來式雙重結構的認知。

questions.question: The park is dirty. We ______ help clean it up next weekend.
questions.commonMisconception: 受到 park is dirty 現在進行的狀況誘導而未注意時間副詞。
questions.explanation: 時間副詞 next weekend 提示未來式。

questions.question:
A: Can you swim?
B: No, but I ______ learn this summer.
questions.commonMisconception: 受 Can you... 開頭影響大腦中的助動詞序列。
questions.explanation: 表示這個暑假的未來決定/計畫，選用 will。

questions.question: If you visit China, you will see the Great Wall. It is very ______.
questions.commonMisconception: 不具備世界地標的基本常識性形容詞對應。
questions.explanation: 萬里長城 (Great Wall) 以其「長」度聞名。

questions.question: In Alishan, you can take a ______ to the top of the mountain.
questions.commonMisconception: 對在地觀光特色不熟悉。
questions.explanation: 阿里山以森林鐵路 (forest train) 聞名。

questions.question:
I am not a bird, but I can fly. I will carry you to Japan.
Question: Who am I?
questions.commonMisconception: 對交通工具與其功能/特徵的對應力不足。
questions.explanation: 會飛且能帶人去日本的交通工具是飛機 (plane)。

questions.question:
A: Do you like the lemon juice?
B: No, it's too ______. I need some sugar.
questions.commonMisconception: 學生可能分不清 sour 與 sweet 的拼寫或含義。
questions.explanation: 檸檬汁的味道通常是酸的 (sour)。後半句說需要糖暗示了目前的酸味。

questions.question: This chocolate cake is very ______. Kids love it!
questions.commonMisconception: 雖然有苦巧克力，但在 G5 程度通常以 sweet 為主標。
questions.explanation: 巧克力蛋糕最常見的描述是甜的 (sweet)。

questions.question: Wow! This soup is so ______. My tongue (舌頭) is burning!
questions.commonMisconception: 單字辨識錯誤。
questions.explanation: 感覺舌頭在燃燒 (burning)，對應的味道是辣的 (spicy)。

questions.question:
A: How ______ the fried chicken taste?
B: It tastes salty.
questions.commonMisconception: 受 taste 當動詞時的狀態影響誤選 Is。
questions.explanation: 主詞 the fried chicken 為第三人稱單數，助動詞使用 does。

questions.question: These grapes ______ very sweet. Do you want one?
questions.commonMisconception: 主謂不一致（忘記 grapes 是複數）。
questions.explanation: 主詞 These grapes 為複數，動詞 taste 不需加 s。

questions.question:
A: Does the pizza taste good?
B: Yes, ______. It's delicious!
questions.commonMisconception: 受 taste 影響誤答 Yes, it tastes（簡答不接一般動詞）。
questions.explanation: 對於 Does 開頭的疑問句，肯定簡答為 Yes, it does。

questions.question: The soup tastes ______ like salt. Maybe you put too much.
questions.commonMisconception: 程度副詞選取不當。
questions.explanation: 「有一點」鹹的味道，使用 a little 修飾。

questions.question: He ______ some sour apples in the kitchen yesterday.
questions.commonMisconception: 時態抓取錯誤。
questions.explanation: 時間副詞 yesterday 提示使用過去式 ate。

questions.question: I would like some ______ cookies, please.
questions.commonMisconception: 形容詞排序規則不熟。
questions.explanation: 形容詞排序：通常大小/形狀 (small) 在感覺 (sweet) 之前。雖然這在 G5 較難，但有助於語感建立。或者在此情境下 small sweet 最自然。

questions.question:
The apple is sweet. The orange is sour. The pineapple is sweet and sour.
Question: Which fruit is ONLY sour?
questions.commonMisconception: 忽略「ONLY」的限定語。
questions.explanation: 文中只描述橘子 (orange) 是酸的。鳳梨是酸甜都有。

questions.question:
Ken: 'This noodles are so spicy!' 
Sam: 'Really? I think they taste salty, not spicy.' 
Question: What does Sam think about the noodles?
questions.commonMisconception: 受第一個說話者 (Ken) 的意見影響而選錯。
questions.explanation: Sam 認為麵吃起來是鹹的 (salty)，不是辣的。

questions.question:
Mochi A has sugar. Mochi B has salt. Mochi C has red beans. 
Question: Which mochi tastes salty?
questions.commonMisconception: 詞性轉換不熟（Salt 名詞 vs Salty 形容詞）。
questions.explanation: 鹽 (salt) 對應的味道是鹹的 (salty)。

questions.question:
Mom: 'Don't eat that soup! It tastes bad.' 
Toby: 'Oh! It is from last week.' 
Question: Why does the soup taste bad?
questions.commonMisconception: 無法從時間描述推論出 bad 的原因。
questions.explanation: 湯是上週的 (from last week)，暗示不新鮮/過期 (old)，導致味道變差。

questions.question:
Summer is hot. We want something cold and sweet. 
Question: What is the best choice (選擇)?
questions.commonMisconception: 不能將多重特徵與複合選項對應。
questions.explanation: 符合「冷」且「甜」的選項是冰淇淋 (Ice cream)。

questions.question: This cake tastes ______ than that cookie.
questions.commonMisconception: 比較級規則混淆。
questions.explanation: 有 than 出現需用比較級，sweet 的比較級為 sweeter。

questions.question: I put too much ______ in the coffee. Now it tastes very salty!
questions.commonMisconception: 邏輯判斷錯誤。
questions.explanation: 咖啡變鹹了，代表誤加了鹽 (salt)。

questions.question: The medicine tastes ______ . I need some water right now!
questions.commonMisconception: 不認識程度較高的味道單字。
questions.explanation: 良藥苦口，且後半句反應劇烈，bitter 最合適。雖然這不是課程主標，但常作為補充。

questions.question: Tofu (臭豆腐) smells bad, but many people think it ______ great!
questions.commonMisconception: 受 smells 吸引而選複數動詞，或受 smells bad 語意干擾。
questions.explanation: 形容食物的味道，主詞 it 配單數動詞 tastes。

questions.question: After school, children in Taiwan like to drink ______ tea. It is sweet and has many pearls.
questions.commonMisconception: 文化常識轉換力弱。
questions.explanation: 有珍珠 (pearls) 且甜的茶是珍珠奶茶 (bubble tea)。

questions.question:
Close your eyes. Taste this. Is it sweet? 
No, it's not. I want to drink water now. My mouth is on fire! 
Question: What does it taste like?
questions.commonMisconception: 不認識慣用語或隱喻描述。
questions.explanation: 「嘴巴著火了」(on fire) 是對辣 (spicy) 的生動描述。

questions.question: Today is our ______ day. We will sing a song to our teachers.
questions.commonMisconception: 學生可能不認識 graduation 的拼寫。
questions.explanation: 畢業典禮當天 (graduation day) 學生通常會唱歌感謝老師。

questions.question: Our ______ will give us a speech (演講) on graduation day.
questions.commonMisconception: 不認識 principal 這個單字。
questions.explanation: 在畢業典禮致詞的人通常是校長 (principal)。

questions.question: I will miss my ______ because we played together for many years.
questions.commonMisconception: 雖然也可能想念書本，但 classmates 在情感連結上最合適。
questions.explanation: 畢業時最令人想念的通常是同學 (classmates)。

questions.question:
A: I'm so sad to leave school.
B: Me, too. But keep in ______, we are best friends forever.
questions.commonMisconception: 與 keep in mind (記住) 混淆，雖語意通但 graduation 情境最常用 touch。
questions.explanation: keep in touch 是「保持聯絡」的固定用法。

questions.question: We ______ many things in this school. I will never forget it.
questions.commonMisconception: 混淆當前狀態與對過去五年（或六年）的回顧時態。
questions.explanation: 回顧過去在學校所學，應使用過去式 learned。

questions.question:
A: How ______ you feel today?
B: I'm happy but a little sad.
questions.commonMisconception: 受 happy (形容詞) 誘導而選用 are (若選 are 則 feel 應為 feeling)。
questions.explanation: 詢問當下的感受 (feel 為動作動詞)，使用助動詞 do。

questions.question:
A: Will you write a card to me?
B: Yes, I ______. Here is my address.
questions.commonMisconception: 簡答助動詞不一致。
questions.explanation: 對 Will 開頭問句的肯定簡答為 Yes, I will。

questions.question: Thank you ______ everything, teachers!
questions.commonMisconception: 介係詞誤用。
questions.explanation: Thank you for ... 為固定搭配，表示為了某事道謝。

questions.question: We sang the graduation song ______ last Friday.
questions.commonMisconception: 形容詞與副詞功能混淆。
questions.explanation: 修飾動詞 sang (唱得如何)，需使用副詞 beautifully。

questions.question:
Amy said: 'I am excited to go to junior high school, but I'm sad to say goodbye to you.' 
Question: How does Amy feel about going to junior high school?
questions.commonMisconception: 將離開的情緒 (sad) 與對未來的期待 (excited) 混淆。
questions.explanation: 文本中提到 'excited to go to junior high school'。

questions.question:
Graduation is in June. Christmas is in December. Now it is May.
Question: Is it graduation day today?
questions.commonMisconception: 邏輯推導錯誤，或是月分順序不熟。
questions.explanation: 現在是五月 (May)，畢業典禮在六月 (June)，故「今天」不是畢業典禮。

questions.question:
In my memory book, Leo wrote: 'See you later!' and Tiana wrote: 'Don't forget me!'. 
Question: What does Tiana want?
questions.commonMisconception: 無法進行日常習慣用語與語意解釋的轉換。
questions.explanation: 'Don't forget me' 對應語意是「希望朋友記得她」。
options: She wants friends to remember her.

questions.question:
We had a party yesterday. We were happy. Tomorrow we will have the graduation day.
Question: What happens tomorrow?
questions.commonMisconception: 時間點（yesterday, today, tomorrow）混淆。
questions.explanation: 文中明確說 'Tomorrow we will have the graduation day'。

questions.question:
Class 5B gave a beautiful flower to their teacher because it was her last day at school. 
Question: Why did they give her a flower?
questions.commonMisconception: 無法提取核心因果關係。
questions.explanation: 關鍵原因是 'it was her last day at school' (她在校的最後一天)，即她要離開學校了。

questions.question:
A: Did you ______ the cake yesterday?
B: Yes, I did. My mother ______ it.
questions.commonMisconception: 不規則動詞 make 的過去式 maked 誤用。
questions.explanation: 助動詞 Did 後接原形動詞 taste；簡答描述過去事實用過去式 made。

questions.question: Please ______ next to me! I want to take a photo of us.
questions.commonMisconception: 受進行中情境誘導選 standing。
questions.explanation: 祈始句使用原形動詞開頭。

questions.question:
A: Good luck (祝好運) in your new school!
B: Thanks! ______
questions.commonMisconception: 應答語誤用。
questions.explanation: 對方給予祝福，回報同樣祝福用 Same to you!。

questions.question: In the picture, the student is wearing a special black ______ . She looks very happy.
questions.commonMisconception: 不具備西方畢業文化之詞彙常識。
questions.explanation: 畢業典禮上的特殊黑色裝備常指畢業大盤帽 (cap)。

questions.question: In Taiwan, many students like to sign (簽名) their names on their ______.
questions.commonMisconception: 文化常識認知力弱。
questions.explanation: 台灣畢業生常有在校服 (uniforms) 上簽名留念的文化。

questions.question:
After G6, we will go to junior high school. 
Question: What grade (年級) will we be in?
questions.commonMisconception: 對年級編制術語不熟。
questions.explanation: 六年級 (G6) 畢業後升上國一，通常指第七學級 (G7)。雖然在台灣習慣稱國一 (Grade 1 of Junior High)，但 12 年一貫制常用 G7 表達。選項中 G7 最合理。

questions.question:
A: Excuse me, I'm looking for the bakery.
B: It's ______ the tea shop and the bookstore. Look for the bread smell!
questions.commonMisconception: 學生可能分不清 between ... and 與 among 的區別。
questions.explanation: 當某個地點位於另外兩個地點中間時，使用介係詞 between (A and B)。

questions.question: The hospital is ______ from the park. You just need to cross (跨越) the street.
questions.commonMisconception: 常漏掉 across 後方的 from，或是將 across 與 through 混淆。
questions.explanation: 「在...對面」且需要穿過馬路的情境，最適合的介係詞是 across (from)。

questions.question: The parking lot (停車場) is ______ the tea shop. You can't see it from the front.
questions.commonMisconception: 單字字義混淆。
questions.explanation: 從前面看不到（can't see it from the front），推論是在建築物的背後 (behind)。

questions.question:
A: ______ the tea shop next to the clinic?
B: Yes, it is.
questions.commonMisconception: 受地點名稱複數感（如：shops）影響誤用 Are。
questions.explanation: 主詞 the tea shop 是第三人稱單數，B 動詞疑問句用 Is 開頭。

questions.question:
A: Where is the bookstore?
B: ______ across from the bank.
questions.commonMisconception: 漏掉 B 動詞或混淆 It's 與 Its。
questions.explanation: 完整句型需要「主詞 + B 動詞」，故選 It's (It is)。

questions.question:
A: Are the boys ______ from the school?
B: No, they are next to the school.
questions.commonMisconception: 方位介係詞的選取不符合邏輯對話。
questions.explanation: 根據否定回答及後續描述地點位置，最可能是詢問「對面」(across from)。

questions.question: The library is between the park ______ the museum.
questions.commonMisconception: 受中文「或」或「與」的翻譯干擾選 or。
questions.explanation: between A ______ B 的固定搭配詞為 and。

questions.question: Welcome to ______! It has the best bubble tea.
questions.commonMisconception: 學生常忽略專有名詞須大寫的規則。
questions.explanation: 作為特定地點名稱或招牌名時，首字母應大寫 (The Tea Shop)。

questions.question: There are two ______ on this street.
questions.commonMisconception: 拼寫規則錯誤。
questions.explanation: 以子音 + y 結尾的名詞，複數變換為去 y 加 ies。

questions.question:
The bakery is across from the clinic. The tea shop is next to the bakery. 
Question: Where is the clinic?
questions.commonMisconception: 缺乏空間對應的雙向邏輯。
questions.explanation: 如果 A 在 B 對面，則 B 也在 A 對面。文中說 bakery 在 clinic 對面。

questions.question:
Amy goes to the bookstore. Then she walks to the tea shop behind the bookstore. 
Question: Where is Amy now?
questions.commonMisconception: 受時間副詞 Then 與地點先後順序混淆。
questions.explanation: Amy 後來走到了茶飲店 (tea shop)，故現在人在茶飲店。

questions.question:
Sam: 'I can see the park. The clinic is behind me. The bakery is across from me.' 
Question: Where is the bakery?
questions.commonMisconception: 多重方位詞的空間建構能力不足。
questions.explanation: Sam 看到公園在前面（假設），診所在後，麵包店在對面，則麵包店與公園在同一側或同一方向（對應 Sam 來說是在公園的方向）。選項中 C 最符合相對位置推論。
options: It is across from the park.
It is across from the clinic.

questions.question:
A clinic is between a tea shop and a library. A library is across from a bakery. 
Question: Is the tea shop across from the bakery?
questions.commonMisconception: 空間推理邏輯不夠嚴謹。
questions.explanation: 根據描述，圖書館在麵包店對面，茶飲店與圖書館分處診所兩側，故茶飲店不一定或通常不在麵包店正對面（診所才是正對面或斜對面）。

questions.question:
The doctor is at the clinic. He wants a cake from the bakery next door. 
Question: Where is the bakery?
questions.commonMisconception: 不認識慣用語 next door。
questions.explanation: next door 即指隔壁、旁邊 (next to)。

questions.question: There is ______ old tea shop across from ______ school.
questions.commonMisconception: 冠詞 a/an 判斷錯誤。
questions.explanation: old 以母音開頭，冠詞用 an；特定學校冠詞常用 the。

questions.question:
A: Oh no! I'm in front of the bank, but I need the clinic behind it!
Question: Where should A go?
questions.commonMisconception: 方位詞與實際行動的邏輯連結斷裂。
questions.explanation: 診所在銀行「後面」(behind it)，應前往建築物後方。
options: Go to the back of the building.

questions.question:
The postman (郵差) is looking for No. 10. It is between No. 8 and No. 12.
Question: Where is No. 10?
questions.commonMisconception: 無法從數字線索轉化為方位描述。
questions.explanation: 介於 8 號與 12 號之間，描述此位置為 between the two houses。

questions.question: In Taiwan, you can find a ______ shop on almost every street corner.
questions.commonMisconception: 不了解在地文化或過度字面閱讀。
questions.explanation: 台灣街頭最普遍的是茶飲店 (tea shop)，這是一項著名的文化特徵。

questions.question: In our school, the gym is ______ the library. We can run there easily.
questions.commonMisconception: 情境推論力不足。
questions.explanation: 「容易跑過去」暗示距離非常近，next to 最合適。

questions.question:
On the map, the green area is the park. The blue area next to it is the museum.
Question: Where is the museum?
questions.commonMisconception: 代名詞 it 的指代與顏色符號對應發生混亂。
questions.explanation: 文中明確說 'blue area next to it (the park)'。
